_architecture_note: This resolves the open question flagged during the original PRD discussion: Fast Punk and Half-Time are NOT two tempos — they are two drum-feel templates played against the SAME master click. Mid-Tempo is a genuinely separate, independently adjustable tempo. Keep 'tempo' and 'feel template' as two distinct state fields in the app; do not hardcode BPM per feel in the UI layer.

feels.label: FAST PUNK
feels.drumFeel: straight-8th-hats, backbeat snare on 2 and 4, kick on 1 and the 'and' of 3

feels.label: HALF-TIME
feels.displayBpmNote: Shown as 90 because the drum FEEL halves — the click/master tempo is still 180.
feels.drumFeel: snare moves to beat 3 only (half-time backbeat), kick on 1, hats stay busy — classic pop-punk breakdown feel

feels.label: MID-TEMPO
feels.drumFeel: skank/offbeat-driven, kick on 1 and 3, hats on the upbeats

uiRequirement: When Feel = Mid-Tempo is selected, render a tempo stepper/slider (120-150, default 140) in place of (or alongside) the static BPM label the mockup currently shows. Fast Punk / Half-Time show a fixed, non-editable BPM readout.
